title: Special Topics in Immersive Media; Sound and Music
description: This course provides an engaging exploration of sound and music principles specifically designed for Immersive Media Design. Students will start with foundational techniques in sound recording and advance to sophisticated hardware considerations that are essential for high-quality audio production in digital environments. The curriculum emphasizes the technical and computational aspects of sound in immersive contexts, covering algorithms for playback systems, synchronization, spatialization of audio, and the creation of generative audio systems.
